investigations.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
investigations.keywords: droplet diffusion flames; fire suppressants CO2/He/SF6; extinction; sooting; cool flames
investigations.objective: Map flammability limits of liquid fuels in microgravity, measure effectiveness of gaseous suppressants (CO2, He, SF6), and build predictive combustion-limit models (burning rates, extinction, radiation, soot).
investigations.raw_folders: Heptane | MeOH | MeOH_Air | Heptane/MeOH x CO2, He, N2, Xe | HiBMs-LCTF calibration

investigations.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment - 2
investigations.keywords: decane; radiative & diffusive extinction; multi-droplet arrays; ethanol; soot formation
investigations.objective: Extend FLEX-1 to realistic fuels/conditions; benchmark bi-component droplet combustion (liquid-phase mixing, extinction mechanisms, droplet arrays, convective flow).
investigations.raw_folders: Binary Array 2014/2015 | Condensed Phase | Quiescent | Surrogate Fuel (decane, octane, propylbenzene, ethanol)

investigations.title: Cool Flames Investigation
investigations.keywords: n-dodecane; iso-dodecane; farnesane; helium dilution; NTC low-temperature chemistry; extinction
investigations.objective: Cool-flame behaviour of n-dodecane and blends at 0.25-5 atm, helium dilution effects, droplet size/pressure vs extinction, and soot during cool-flame combustion.

investigations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids
investigations.keywords: flame spread; fire suppression; Damkohler number; forced flow; fabrics, PMMA, SIBAL
investigations.objective: Bridge NASA-STD-6001 Test 1 and real microgravity flammability using realistic thick fuels; assess inert gaseous extinguishing agent effectiveness.

investigations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II
investigations.keywords: flame spread; extinction limits; low-velocity forced flow; PMMA; fire suppression
investigations.objective: Ignition, growth, spread and extinction limits of solid fuels in low-speed forced flow; links to NASA-STD-6001; preliminary data for SoFIE.
investigations.raw_folders: by PI: Bhattacharjee | Ferkul | Fernandez-Pello | Miller | Olson | T'ien

investigations.title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I
investigations.keywords: large-scale fire growth; SIBAL fabric; concurrent flow; flammability limits
investigations.objective: How rapidly a large-scale fire grows in low gravity and how low-g flammability limits compare with the 1-g NASA screening test.

investigations.title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-II
investigations.keywords: silicone, Nomex, SIBAL, PMMA samples; smoldering; smoke distribution
investigations.objective: Large-scale fire growth rate and low-g flammability limits of 9 spacecraft materials vs the 1-g screening test.

investigations.title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-III
investigations.keywords: large-scale flame spread; SIBAL; low-gravity fire testing
investigations.objective: Large-scale fire growth and low-g flammability limits (repeat of Saffire-I with new conditions).

investigations.title: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment
investigations.keywords: smoke particle size; Teflon, Kapton, silicone, cotton, DBP; smoke detector design
investigations.objective: Quantify low-g smoke particle sizes vs smoke generation/transport conditions to inform spacecraft smoke detectors.

investigations.title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight
investigations.keywords: smoke; TEM grids; thermal precipitators; Kapton, Pyrell, Teflon, silicone, cotton
investigations.objective: Reflight of SAME with improved thermal precipitators to measure smoke droplet size distributions in low gravity.
investigations.raw_folders: Cotton Lamp wick | Kapton | Pyrell | Silicone | Teflon

investigations.title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test 1 & 2
investigations.keywords: P-Trak condensation nuclei counter; DustTrak; aerosol measurement in microgravity
investigations.objective: Show a modified P-Trak particle counter works in microgravity (risk reduction for SAME).

investigations.title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
investigations.keywords: smoke point; soot emissions; laminar coflow diffusion flames; ethylene, propane
investigations.objective: Laminar smoke-point properties of non-buoyant jet flames vs coflow, burner diameter and fuel; sooting propensity.

investigations.title: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment
investigations.keywords: lifted diffusion flames; fuel dilution; inlet velocity; flame stability
investigations.objective: Structure and stability of laminar diffusion flames in microgravity; liftoff limits; dilution effect on soot and stability.

investigations.title: ACME - Burning Rate Emulator
investigations.keywords: burning rate; heat flux; radiative extinction; spacecraft atmospheres (14.7 psia/21% O2 ... 8.2 psia/34% O2)
investigations.objective: Emulate burning of condensed fuels with gaseous fuels on porous burners to relate flammability to material properties in spacecraft atmospheres.

investigations.title: ACME - Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame
investigations.keywords: coflow flames; methane, ethylene; lift-off; soot volume fraction; extinction limits
investigations.objective: Characterize weak and sooty coflow diffusion flames vs velocity and fuel dilution (shape, lift-off, temperature, extinction, soot).

investigations.title: ACME - Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames
investigations.keywords: ion-driven wind; chemi-ionization; electric field; soot; lifted flames
investigations.objective: Relationship between electric-field voltage and ion current, dynamic flame response, soot formation and near-limit lifted flames.
investigations.raw_folders: Co-Flow / Gas-Jet burner x positive / negative supply

investigations.title: ACME - Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames
investigations.keywords: spherical diffusion flames; H2/CH4/C2H4; radiative & kinetic extinction; flame structure
investigations.objective: Transient structure and quasi-steady extinction limits of spherical diffusion flames for model validation.

investigations.title: ACME - Flame Design
investigations.keywords: soot inception; normal & inverse spherical flames; stoichiometric mixture fraction; radiative extinction
investigations.objective: Soot-inception limits and extinction of normal/inverse spherical flames vs flow, Zst, diluent and pressure (design of soot-free flames).
investigations.raw_folders: normal ethylene/propane, inverse ethylene burner sets

investigations.title: ACME - Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
investigations.keywords: cool diffusion flames; ethane, propane, n-butane; low-temperature chemistry
investigations.objective: Conditions for cool diffusion flames of gaseous fuels (normal & inverse) and validated kinetics via CFD.

investigations.title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics (CFD)
investigations.keywords: cool flames; droplet drift; OpenFOAM 3-D CFD; extinction diameter
investigations.objective: Quantify how heating and drift-induced convection change droplet cool-flame dynamics; stability maps from CFD validated on FLEX.

investigations.title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation/Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
investigations.keywords: cool flame flammability limits; ozone-assisted counterflow; radiation extinction
investigations.objective: Flammability/extinction diagram for diffusional cool flames using FLEX data plus counterflow experiments and modelling.

investigations.title: Utilization of SAME Data for Modeling of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
investigations.keywords: smoke nanoparticle growth; thermophoresis; Earth vs microgravity simulations
investigations.objective: Numerical simulation of gravity's influence on pyrolysis smoke growth (1-g vs 0-g).

investigations.title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds vs BASS
investigations.keywords: flame spread modeling; FGM; two-color tomography
investigations.objective: Develop/validate unsteady flamelet-generated-manifold models for concurrent flame spread against BASS imagery.

investigations.title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
investigations.keywords: soot volume fraction; temperature; coflow flames; 1g vs 0g
investigations.objective: Derive temperature and soot volume fraction from 1600+ SPICE images and reconcile 1g vs 0g sooting.
